subject: Renewal & commit increase — Hosted API renewal (Lucent Retail)
messages:
From: Jordan Park <jordan.park@lucentretail.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@lucentretail.com>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal discussion + potential commit increase

Hi Olga,

Hope you had a good week. Our renewal with Redwood is coming up at the end of June and we
want to discuss increasing our monthly committed tokens for the hosted API. We saw a 45%
q/q spike in peak traffic for checkout personalization and expect similar growth through Q4.

High-level ask: can we move from our current 8M token/month commitment to a 20M token/month
commit with a 12-month term? We care about predictable throughput during US peak hours and
want to avoid soft-throttle disruptions.

Specific asks:
- Preliminary pricing for 20M/month (any step-downs for a 12-month commitment)
- How rate limits / per-route QPS would change with that commit level
- A simple rollout plan for gradual ramp over 60 days (we'd like to start a phased ramp in July)

Copying Elena from procurement — she will handle the PO and timeline. Can you share a quick
proposal and any paperwork we should expect?

Thanks,
Jordan Park
Head of Platform Engineering
Lucent Retail

Attachments: none (we'll send usage snapshot if you need it).

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Park <jordan.park@lucentretail.com>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@lucentretail.com>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + potential commit increase

Jordan — thanks for the context and congrats on the growth. Happy to run this through and
put together a clear path. Quick answers up front, details below: 

- We can support a 20M token/month hosted commit on a 12-month term. I can share pricing 
  tiers and an amendment template by EOD.
- Rate limits: for a 20M commit we recommend bumping per-route QPS from your current 60 QPS
  to a baseline 160 QPS with a staged increase to 240 QPS during peak windows; we will 
  provision a soft-reservation to avoid immediate throttling during ramp.
- Rollout plan: 0–30 days: 50% volume routing to upgraded pool; 30–60 days: 100% routing +
  post-ramp observability checks.

I attached a short commit options packet and a provisioning estimate workbook to show 
expected utilization and costs for different ramp profiles. Can you send the usage snapshot 
Jordan mentioned (30-day token heatmap by hour) — that will let our provisioning team size 
GPU pools and suggest a concrete autoscale policy.

Next steps:
1) If Lucent is comfortable with the 20M/12mo outline I’ll send a one-page amendment + SOW
   that legal can take a first pass on.
2) Karthik (cc'd) will prepare the commercial terms and a one-time onboarding credit for the
   staged ramp.
3) We’ll schedule a 30-minute ops sync to confirm rerouting and rate-limits.

Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0124

Attachments:
- commit_options_v2.pdf (PDF summary of pricing/tiers)
- provisioning_estimate.xlsx (workbook for utilization/ramp scenarios)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal discussion + potential commit increase — need pricing and credit plan

Team — forwarding Lucent's note below. TL;DR: they want to move from 8M -> 20M tokens/mo for 12
months, phased ramp July–Aug. Elena from procurement will own PO timing.

Can you: 
- Karthik: draft two commercial options (20M flat rate and a stepped ladder 12/9/6 months)
  and include a recommended onboarding credit for spike protection (10–15% token credit).
- Priyom: confirm whether we can guarantee the per-route QPS bump (160 -> 240 QPS) via a
  soft-reservation; ops impact if they ramp in that 60-day window.
- Marissa: CSM touchpoint for the ops sync; please prep the post-ramp checklist.

Jordan's initial questions are below — we should aim to reply to Lucent with an amendment 
and a pricing appendix by EOD Monday. If legal needs a controlled SOW draft I have a Lucent 
SOW template — attaching my redline.

Thanks — Olga

Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + potential commit increase

Olga — appreciate the quick turnaround. The outline looks good and Elena confirms budgeting
approval for the 12-month commit. A couple of clarifying points before we sign: 

1) On rate limits: our checkout service is very sensitive to tail latency. Can you confirm
   if the per-route QPS bump comes with any changes to token-level latency SLOs? We want to
   ensure our p99 latency stays within 350ms for generation calls during peak.
2) On credits: a 10% onboarding credit sounds fair. Would Redwood consider an incremental
   safeguard (temporary burst buffer) for the first 30 days purely for safety during the ramp?
3) Timeline: Procurement requests a signed amendment + PO by Friday 21 May to ensure July
   provisioning. Is that feasible?

If you can get a one-page amendment and a DocuSign link with the pricing appendix, we can
route the PO to Elena and finish legal review quickly.

Thanks,
Jordan

—
Jordan Park
Head of Platform Engineering
Lucent Retail

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Park <jordan.park@lucentretail.com>, Elena Morris <elena.morris@lucentretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + potential commit increase — next steps and DocuSign

Jordan / Elena — great, thank you. Final summary and next steps below (confirming items from our
internal pricing/ops sync):

Agreed commercial path:
- Commit: 20M tokens / month, 12-month term (deal ID: LUC-2026-58)
- Pricing: flat rate $0.0016 per token with a 10% onboarding credit applied to first invoice
- One-time onboarding credit: token credit equivalent to 10% of first month (applied as invoice
  line item).
- Temporary burst buffer: a 30-day burst pocket of 2M tokens that will not count toward soft-throttle
  for the initial ramp window.

Ops & SLA notes:
- Per-route QPS: baseline 160 QPS -> staged 240 QPS for peak windows; ops will monitor p99
  latency and commit to an alert threshold at 350ms. If latency regression occurs during the
  60-day ramp we will temporarily divert traffic and open a priority incident.

Timing & paperwork:
- I attached the one-page amendment (Lucent_AMENDMENT_draft.docx) and the pricing appendix.
- DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcdef-123456
- Requested by procurement: signed amendment + PO by 2026-05-21. We can meet that date if 
  we receive the PO by EOD Friday.

Action items:
- Jordan / Elena: confirm acceptance of the pricing and the 30-day burst buffer (reply-all)
- Elena: share PO timing once procurement has it queued
- Karthik / Priyom: I will send final amendment to DocuSign after Jordan confirms.
- Marissa: schedule ops sync for 30 May (30 min) to review rerouting runbook and monitoring playbook.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this through.

Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
